description: This file defines a Java Servlet Filter class 'AppAuthUserFilter' responsible for extracting an authentication user ID from incoming HTTP requests, logging it, and setting it in a request context for subsequent processing.

classes.name: AppAuthUserFilter
classes.description: A servlet filter that handles extracting an authentication user ID from request headers and managing request context.

methods.name: doFilter
methods.description: Processes incoming requests by extracting the user ID from headers, logging, setting context, and ensuring cleanup after request handling.
